name: Natural Questions
description: A question answering dataset of real user queries issued to Google, paired with Wikipedia pages containing long-answer and short-answer annotations.
citation: Kwiatkowski, T., Palomaki, J., Redfield, O., Collins, M., Parikh, A., Alberti, C., et al. (2019). Natural Questions: A Benchmark for Question Answering Research. Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics, 7, 453–466. https://doi.org/10.1162/tacl_a_00276

license.notes: The upstream project does not specify a standard SPDX license for the dataset. Access to the downloadable dataset requires accepting Google's dataset terms; review those terms and the separate rights applicable to Wikipedia content before use or redistribution.
